entries.message: On Mac, a page shown in WebKit now uses its own background colour when you scroll past its edges, starting with the first page a tab loads.
On iPhone and iPad, running low on memory now unloads one background tab instead of several, so fewer tabs reload when you go back to them.
Remove the sidebar's drop-indicator code, which never drew anything since the in-place reorder replaced it.
Trim the test suites to the contracts that can break silently: persistence, sync, privacy, security, extensions, input routing and shared session rules.
Share the window colour, sheet sizing and text field settings between Mac and iPhone, and drop platform stand-ins that did nothing.
Keep the core's Space lookups, history expiry and seed repair in one place each, on the session and its Spaces.
Remove core commands the app never sends: cancelling a close check, moving a whole split and removing history by date range.
Remove page plumbing nothing used: a new-tab callback no page called, an empty navigation hook and stand-in protocols with a single implementation.
Bundle the emoji picker's catalog as a data file instead of compiling it into the app, which speeds up builds.
Keep one definition each in the core for the stored-date epoch, ordered device-store writes and known URL schemes, and show a sync save failure's own message.
Show web and extension notifications through one shared path that checks permission, trims long text and withdraws stale ones.
Move the Space selector out of the design system into Spaces, settings layout into the design system and page state models next to the page.
Remove the in-app performance harness and other code only retired tests and tools used.
Share WebKit link decisions, sign-in and certificate challenges, permission requests and script dialogs between Mac and iPhone pages.
Build the iPad keyboard menu from the same command table the command palette uses, with the same items, shortcuts and enabled states.
Bind the sidebar to a window's pages once for Mac and iPhone, with the Mac adding tab sharing and audio.
Set up an iPhone or iPad window's pages in one place, so the app and each window wire sign-ins, links and Peeks the same way.
Use one message proxy for every page script bridge instead of a copy per bridge.
Track a dragged sidebar folder or tab with one drag session type instead of two copies.
End an iPhone or iPad sidebar drag through one shared step once the system reports it finished.
The Space menu and the iPhone page menu now name and show commands the way the menu bar does, such as Clear Unpinned Tabs and Show History.
A folder you make without naming it is called New Folder in the app's language, not always in English.
The Chromium engine's pages answer the app's page requests themselves, through one path instead of a forwarding handler each.
Decide in one place whether a Chromium extension may run in a private window's profile.
Carry a staged link's identity as a UUID rather than as text both engines parse back.
Synced visits spell their fields from the one table the stored session uses.
Synced folders spell their fields from one table.
Synced tabs and archived tabs spell their fields from one table.
Synced Spaces and splits spell their fields from one table.
Read and write a sync record's envelope in one place.
